column2: The stalemate drags on for about two months... ||| Using this time, the acting representative makes contact with the Imperial Army Intelligence Division... ||| and begins preparing the operation that will later lead to the resolution of the incident.
From: Imperial Army Intelligence Division, Section 1. To: General Staff. ||| "Subject C.B. has made contact with a Section operative. Currently verifying..."
From: Imperial Army Intelligence Division, Section 1. To: General Staff. ||| "Subject C.B. has proposed a joint operation. Next contact scheduled at the designated time and place..."
~ Tactical Analysis of the Bracer Guild Branch Attacks ~ ||| Intelligence Division, Section 2

...What broke the deadlock was the acting representative C.B.'s skillful maneuvering. ||| Having contacted a Section operative, C.B. had a message sent to the General Staff, expecting the enemy to intercept it.
The enemy intercepted it, learned the time and place of the next contact, and planned to eliminate C.B.... ||| ...which was exactly what he had intended.

During the contact, our operative also received an encrypted document... ||| It already contained a detailed plan to annihilate, with Imperial forces, the enemy group lured in by false information. ||| The General Staff approved the plan. And through joint operations with the Bracer Guild...

The enemy force assembled to eliminate C.B. was completely surrounded and successfully disarmed. ||| Remnants hiding at other bases were defeated piecemeal with the cooperation of prisoners... ||| ...and several months after it began, the Jester Jaeger Corps was dismantled.

From: Imperial Army Intelligence Division, Section 1. To: General Staff. ||| "As of today, the threat rating of Cassius Bright (S-rank bracer) has been revised..." ||| "...from Level 4 to the maximum, Level 5: a grave threat to national security. Thorough surveillance is required upon entry into the country."

From: Imperial Army Intelligence Division, Section 1. To: General Staff. ||| "The subject under surveillance has left the country today. No particular disturbance upon departure... Further duties are transferred to overseas agencies. ...End of transmission."

From: General Staff Special Investigation Office. To: His Excellency the Chancellor. ||| "...C.B.'s departure has likewise been confirmed. Pursuit continues, but no unexpected movements at present." ||| "Contact with the Performer has also yet to be confirmed. We will continue to scrutinize both parties' movements."
Episode "The Imperial Guild Serial Attacks" ~Fin~
Loading > > > > > Complete
The Thirteen Workshops: Gordias-Class Strategic Doll Weapon Development Plan ||| Code name: Pater-Mater

Development goal: ||| To complete a new model inheriting the design philosophy of the Gordias series, equipped with a more advanced control system. ||| In addition to the strategic deployment emphasized in earlier models, this plan aims to enable precise and flexible tactical deployment as well.
Operational range: the entire continent. ||| It shall carry two high-output orbal engines, main and auxiliary, capable of sustained combat for years without resupply.

Implementing the integrated orbal processor Mars will enable advanced target assessment and autonomous combat... ||| Furthermore, by using the pilot's nervous system for control, we aim to achieve reflexive, instinctive movement. ||| Communication with the pilot will be contactless, and a suitable subject will be selected from among the candidates.
Height: 15.5 arges. Body weight: 55 trims. (68 trims fully armed.)

In addition to various orbal weapons centered on an orbal energy cannon, it will carry several gunpowder weapons as backup. ||| For the pilot's safety, it will also be fitted with the Revival System, a mechanism that uses a tactical orbment to generate healing and revival energy.
The armor plating will be made of the alloy Kurdaregon. ||| In every respect, this alloy boasts the highest performance currently available. ||| For detailed strength data, refer to the Gospel Plan.

Development is proceeding smoothly under Dr. Novartis's design. ||| Power supply tests to each actuator have already succeeded... ||| However, the Doctor is displeased with the poor responsiveness of the flight engine. (In particular, the low response of the anti-gravity generator.) ||| Tactical deployment is judged impossible in its current state. In addition to levitation by the flight engine, we are considering adding booster thrust...

Actuator development is proving difficult, since existing doll weapons cannot be adapted. ||| The enlarged main armament has increased combat weight, and durability tests on the leg joints are running into problems. ||| Improvement should be possible by avoiding load concentration through precision control...

The main weapon, the orbal energy cannon, has already completed live-fire testing... ||| However, on Dr. Novartis's instruction, a twin-barrel version is under consideration and implementation is postponed. ||| The resulting increase in required output should fall within the capacity of the new orbal engine.
The control system is currently under experiment... ||| Refer to the separate section for detailed results.

Control tests using the nervous system are still ongoing... ||| However, the expected precision has not been achieved to this day. ||| The main test results from Dr. Novartis's team can be viewed above.

Subject Code A1 ... Abnormal reaction at connection phase 2, unconscious. Subject Code B3 ... Abnormal reaction at connection phase 3, cardiac arrest. Subject Code C1 ... Abnormal reaction at connection phase 1, loss of sanity.

Subject Code D7 ... Abnormal reaction at connection phase 2, unconscious. Subject Code E3 ... Abnormal reaction at connection phase 2, cardiac arrest. Subject Code F2 ... Abnormal reaction at connection phase 2, unconscious.

Subject Code G4 ... Abnormal reaction at connection phase 3, unconscious. Subject Code H1 ... Abnormal reaction at connection phase 2, unconscious. Subject Code I6 ... Abnormal reaction at connection phase 4, mental collapse.
...All subjects failed to adapt. ||| We plan to continue the experiments with subjects provided by the Society.

...The Society has issued a notice of temporary suspension. ||| The reason is that stability of the control system has not been confirmed. ||| Hereafter, subjects participating in connection tests will be limited to candidates selected by the Society.
Subject Code R3... Still alive after the phase 4 connection test. ||| *However, mild flashbacks observed.

Subject Code R3... Succeeded in communicating with Pater-Mater. ||| We are asking the Society to resume development... Code R3 has already succeeded in piloting the actual machine. ||| We are asking the Society to resume development...
Episode "The Gordias-Class Experiment Plan" ~Fin~
...What's wrong, Renne? You've been awfully quiet.
...Why...? ||| Why is everyone... able to keep smiling?
Huh...?
Renne...?
Because... we're saying goodbye. ||| We might never see each other again... ||| How can you part with a smile like that...?
Renne...
Then... why don't we all just stay here?! ||| If the Garden is safe, I can remake Phantasma however I like...! ||| Our fun, cheerful tea party could go on forever and ever! ||| Why is everyone...!
I see... So that's it... ||| You're hurt by the thought of never seeing someone again, aren't you?
Not being able to see someone you love... someone you want to be with... ||| That's what hurt, wasn't it.
Ah...
T-that's not true! ||| It can't... possibly be true! ||| Because Renne didn't hurt when she heard Loewe died! ||| I was really sad, but it didn't "hurt"!

That's because, Renne. ||| I think you've accepted Loewe's death. ||| Since you know you can't see him again, you were able to grieve honestly. ||| ...But when you could see someone you love, and yet can't... ||| that really is the most painful thing of all.
No... no, it's not...!
That's why you did that to Estelle...
I said it's not true!
Hey, Renne. Want me to tell you? ||| Why we can say goodbye with a smile.
...I don't want to know...! I don't want to hear it...!
...It's because, ||| whether it's someone you love or someone you hate... ||| no matter who it is, a farewell is always waiting.

It's the same for me and Joshua. ||| Even if we got married, had kids, and stayed together forever... ||| when one of us reaches the end of our life, we'll surely be separated. ||| And of course, an accident, or our feelings drifting apart, could split us up too. ||| I think all of us are fighting that kind of fear.
Estelle...
...Estelle...
But that's exactly why we laugh!

By laughing together, we blow that fear away! ||| When we all laugh together, we can feel we're not alone! ||| We can feel the thrill and excitement of maybe seeing each other again! ||| We tough it out like that, promise to meet again, and walk our separate paths... ||| ...I think that's how it is for everyone.
Everyone...
Yeah, everyone. ||| So, Renne... laugh with us, okay?
I can't promise to stay together forever... ||| But I like you, Renne. ||| I want to watch over you until you grow up. ||| So until then... no matter what happens, I'll be with you.
Ugh... ah...

And then... when you grow up and find what you truly want to do... ||| If that path means leaving us... ||| then we'll say goodbye with our biggest smiles. ||| I don't know what the future holds, but... how about starting from there?
Uuu... aah... ||| ...Th-that's... that's...
You don't have to decide right away. ||| We've already made up our minds, after all.
Renne... to become your family.
Well, it's just what we hope, of course. ||| Dad's okay with it too, so it's up to you now.
Enough... that's enough already!
...Renne...
...Then...! Then Renne will run away with all her might! ||| I'll run as hard as I can so Estelle and Joshua can't catch me...! ||| ...So... so...!
Yes, bring it on. ||| Keep running until you make up your mind.
Heh, just so you know, I never give up~! ||| No matter how good you are at hide-and-seek, I'll find you for sure!
Uuu...! ...I hate you...
I hate you both, Estelle and Joshua!
...But... I love you just as much...!
Ahaha... ||| ...Finally... we finally got through... ||| ...Our words... to that girl...
Ugh... uuu... ||| ...Joshua... Joshuaaa...
Yeah... You did well.
...But this is still only the beginning.
Yeah... yeah... ||| ...*sniff*...
Sorry... Kevin, Ries. ||| We... have to go now...
Yeah... You're going after her, right? ||| Go on and chase her down with everything you've got.
May the blessing of the Goddess be with the three of you... ||| I look forward to seeing you again, all three together.
Yeah... Leave it to us!
And you two... please stay well until then!
Amazing... ...Estelle and the others.
Yeah... I take my hat off to them.
But seeing that... I really start to believe it exists. ||| The place Sis was aiming for... the place she was trying to reach.
...Yeah... ||| We can't lose to them, either.
This place... won't hold much longer. ||| Now... you two should hurry as well.
Yeah...
Huh... but...
What's up?
Well... ...I feel like we forgot something...
Heeey...!
Ah!
Oh my...
Haa... haa... haa...
H-how awful! ||| Leaving me behind with just that explanation!
I-I'm sorry. I was tied up at the time... ||| But with that explanation, couldn't you find your way here?
N-not to brag, but I have no sense of direction at all! ||| I was chased by a mob of angels, nearly run over by a horse-drawn chariot...
M-more importantly... what is this shaking?
Oh, this castle's about to disappear. ||| The exit back to the original world is over there, so you'd better escape quick, mister.
T-then say so sooner! ||| I can't stay here... I'm going!
Yes... please go ahead. ||| ...Thank you for your hard work.
Huh...
Well, good work, both of us. ||| Next time we meet, we'll be enemies... ||| Try not to get too reckless, or the Order will have its eyes on you.
Ha, haha... ||| Heh, that's my line. ||| Next time we meet, I'll show you how much I've risen in rank and power... ||| Look forward to it!
Haha...
...Hehe...
Now... you two should hurry as well. ||| It will hold a few minutes more at best.
...Understood. ||| Miss Celeste... what will happen to you now?
I will fall into a long sleep once more in the Garden. ||| Until the day this Phantasma gradually vanishes. ||| And then, at last... I will be freed from this role.
I see... ||| Thank you for everything.
...Please, sleep well.
Heh, thank you. ||| Once you've left, I will shut down the function of the Sept-Stone. ||| It will never revive again, so please dispose of it as you see fit.
...Understood. ||| I expect we'll entrust it to the proper person.
Kevin... are you planning to give it to Dr. Erika?
Well, she'd never settle down otherwise. ||| Not with her dear child caught up in all this.
...Maybe so.
Well then, Ries. Shall we get going too?
Yeah... ||| ...Would you like to hold hands as we go?
...Heh, just kidding. ||| But let's go together. ||| To the place Sister dreamed of... the place we'll someday reach.
Yeah...
Looking forward to working with you again, partner!
Yeah...!
...I don't know... ||| But it seems certain this guy interfered somehow. ||| Including destroying every quartz we were carrying.

* The Grail Notebook is now available. ||| You can look up story events and detailed orbment explanations in this notebook. ||| * To open the Grail Notebook, use it from the [Books] category of the camp screen's [Items] tab, or press the Triangle button + Left on the D-pad.
Could it be...!
Hmm... To think he was drawn in as well.
The main event arrives, as they say.
...You know him?
Haha, you got it. ||| In a word... you could call him the dark-haired prince.
Ngh...
Estelle! Get down on the floor, now...
What...!?
J-Joshua...!
Big Brother Joshua!
Josette... and even Tita... ||| ...A dream... no, some kind of offensive illusion...?
Haha, you're sharp to think of that. ||| Sorry to say, though... this is neither a dream nor an illusion.
Kevin... and Julia and Major Mueller too...
What on earth... is going on here?
Um... ||| I guess that explanation alone isn't enough to convince you?
...No, quite the opposite. ||| I considered an illusion, but then I couldn't explain the presence of this person.
Yes. ||| Forgive me, but you seem to be one of the Order...?
...You can tell.
Yes, being Kevin's companion and carrying a Gale Sword. ||| ...My name is Joshua. Joshua Bright.
...Apprentice Knight of the Grail, Ries Argent. ||| You seem to be familiar with our world.
H-hey, Joshua! ||| How does her being here prove it isn't an illusion? ||| And right in front of me, too!
Come to think of it... I haven't seen that visor before. ||| It suits you... Is it for the delivery business you mentioned?
Oh, yeah, thanks to you, business is booming. ||| ...No, that's not the point! ||| Anyone can see at a glance that I'm the real thing!

With illusions, the people who appear are usually acquaintances. ||| It's a technique that guides and manipulates the knowledge and images the target already holds. ||| Ries, on the other hand, is a complete stranger to me... ||| yet she has a background complex enough to be convincing. ||| With someone like that present, I judged an illusion unlikely.
I-I sort of get it, and sort of don't... ||| ...So basically, since you know me so well, I'm no proof either way?
Well, yes... You could put it that way.
Heh... then that's fine!
Hehe... ||| Um, Big Brother Joshua. It's been such a long time!
Yeah, you look well, Tita. ||| It's been about half a year... You seem to have grown a little taller.
Ehehe...
But I never expected you to be caught up in this too... ||| It must have been quite a shock.
Yes... I still feel like I'm dreaming. ||| Oh, that's right... Big Brother Joshua... ||| Um, so, where is Big Sister Estelle...?
...I don't know. ||| But I'm sure she was caught in the white light along with me. ||| It seems likely she was drawn into this place, Phantasma.
I-I see... ||| By the way, where have you two been traveling lately? ||| I know from your letters you were in Erebonia until recently...
Yes, right now we're in a place called Crossbell. ||| A small autonomous state between the Empire and the Republic...
Really!? ||| Our Lynx was flying right over that area, too...
Is that so? ||| Hmm... I wonder if there's a connection.
Hmm, if anything, it would be the distance from Liberl. ||| We were staying in Paum, the city nearest the border.
I see...
...Father Kevin. ||| Suppose this situation was caused by some powerful Artifact... ||| could its influence possibly reach this wide an area?
No... I doubt it could. ||| The nearest example would be the Aureole's orbal shutdown phenomenon. ||| I heard it affected even the southern Empire.
I see... ||| Then it would take power comparable to the Sept-Terrion. ||| Come to think of it, the Aureole vanished somewhere...
C-could it be...!?
...That possibility certainly exists. ||| But it's also true that far too much remains unexplained by it alone.
The "enemy"... and the Royal Capital turned into another world.
...In addition, demons taking physical form, and changes in elemental effects. ||| I think we shouldn't rush to a conclusion until those are explained.
Hmm... True enough.
But in that case... ||| it seems we must first solve the mystery of the transformed Royal Capital.
Yeah, that's right. ||| I know you're worried about Estelle, but... will you help us out?
...That was my intention all along. ||| With everyone caught up in this, it's not someone else's problem. ||| Above all, cooperating with Kevin and the others seems the quickest way to find Estelle.
Big Brother Joshua...
Sigh... well, can't be helped.
All right! ||| Pleased to be working with you, then.
...Once we've prepared, let's head back to the Royal Capital. ||| Joshua's release may have changed something.
Understood.
* No message
She really respects Uncle Cassius so much... ||| Honestly, Agate, you're such a stubborn one...
(That's what she says, but... ...Agate?)
(So she says... ...Agate?)
(That's what she says, Senior Agate!)
(That's what she says, Agate...)
(D-don't pass it to me.)
...Agate says he's actually really glad to have fought Uncle Cassius. ||| But next time he wants to meet the real one and pound him senseless... ||| Why are men like that?
...Agate says he wanted to fight Uncle Cassius. ||| ...Even though he really respects him so much... ||| Why are men like that?
He really respects him so much... ||| Honestly, Agate, you're such a stubborn one...
(I... I can't say anything...)
She really respects Uncle Cassius so much... ||| And yet talking about fighting him or settling the score... ||| Why are men like that?
I think Kirika went back to her country a little before Grandpa left on his trip. ||| One day she suddenly came to our house and said she'd be taking her leave soon...
That sounds just like Kirika...
Haha, I can picture it perfectly...

Oh, that's right. I completely forgot... ||| I wonder if the Chief is all right... ||| Another incident has happened because of Mom's research... ||| And Kirika, who always helps us, is gone too... ||| The Chief might be collapsing right about now...
(Haha... Looks like she's dozing off a bit.)
(We released Tita from the sealing stone first.) ||| (She's probably getting tired by now.)
(...Can't be helped. Let's let her rest a bit.)
(Yeah, you're right.)
(...Estelle, let's let her rest a little.)
(...Estelle, let's let her rest for a bit.)
(Well, then it can't be helped. Let's let her rest a little.)
(...So cute...)

I'm worried about Kevin's condition too... ||| The Shadow Lord seemed to have predicted that Kevin would collapse after using his Stigma. ||| And that if he did, Phantasma would come closer to completion... ||| Um, please be even more careful exploring from here on. ||| I don't want anyone else to get hurt...
Until now, the Shadow Lord never harmed anyone directly... ||| but it seems that's no longer the case. ||| Please be more careful than ever when exploring from here.
Oh, Big Sister Estelle. ||| Um, how is Kevin doing...?
Yeah, I think he'll be fine. ||| Josette is looking after him right now.
Yeah, I think he'll be fine. ||| Kloe is looking after him right now.
Yeah, I think he'll be fine. ||| Joshua is looking after him right now.
Yeah, I think he'll be fine. ||| Joshua and Kloe are looking after him right now.
I-I see... ||| Phew, that's a relief...
Um... ||| ...I'm sorry. I caused you worry.
Huh...?
Um... Why are you apologizing, Ries?
............... ||| True enough. ||| Please forget what I just said.
F-forget it, she says...
So, about this place... ||| Whereas the Back Tower was a flat dimensional space, this pocket dimension's layered structure is...
Tita, wait here a bit. ||| I'm going to check out this pocket dimension or whatever it is.
Oh, okay! ||| Um, please be careful!
You don't have to tell me.
Whereas the Back Tower was a flat dimensional space, this pocket dimension's layered structure is...
...I'm going to check out this pocket dimension or whatever. ||| Tita, hold down the fort.
But really, I'm so glad you're safe, Agate. ||| I was so, so worried something might have happened to you too...
Even so, quit clinging to me. ||| And Tita, you...
...You didn't run into any danger where I couldn't see, did you?
Um... ||| I-I think I'm fine. ||| I was with Kevin and the others...
I see... ||| Then there's nothing more to say. ||| All that's left is to rescue everyone who's sealed and get out of this weird world.
Hey, Father, take me along. ||| Pocket dimension, Shadow Lord, whatever it is, I want to understand this situation as much as I can.
As expected of Agate. ||| You're fired up, aren't you...
Hey, Father, let's get moving. ||| Pocket dimension, Shadow Lord, whatever it is, I want to understand this situation as much as I can.

We're moving by teleport circles and Sept-Stones, so I can't tell for sure... ||| but it feels like the deeper we go into the Strata, the further down we're going. ||| I-if so... what's at the very bottom?
We've figured out a lot about the Rules... ||| but there's still so much we don't know about Phantasma. ||| What is the Shadow Lord trying to do...?
Hehe, still, I'm so glad... ||| that we were able to free Big Brother Joshua... ||| But Big Sister Estelle has probably been pulled in too, right? ||| We have to find her quick and free her...
Oh, and Olivier too...
Hm...? ||| Ah, no need to worry about him. ||| He must have some resolve of his own. A little sealing won't get him down.
So the people who got pulled in really are sealed inside the sealing stones. ||| We have to hurry and find them and set them free...

I think this pocket dimension can still be explained. ||| In the Zemurian era, they apparently had the technology to create dimensional spaces like the Back Tower... ||| But the sealing stones with people inside, and that strange Royal Capital, I still can't explain...
Um, um... ||| There's just too much I don't understand. ||| I wish we had a few more clues...
...Artifact... pocket dimension... s-sealing stone...?
...Mumble, mumble...
...Maybe she's hungry.
No, no, that's not it.
What's wrong, Tita? ||| ...Are you okay?
Oh... y-yes. ||| Sorry, I spaced out a little... ||| There's just so much I don't understand, and, um...
It's all right. We don't understand it either.
Oh, but I'll do my best! ||| When you go exploring, please don't hesitate to take me along!
R-roger.
Haaaaah...!!
(What intensity...) ||| (Hmm... As her rival, I can't lose to this...!)
Not yet... ||| This is only the beginning...!
Mmm... ||| Mmmmm...!!
Um, Anelace...? ||| W-what's gotten into you...!?
...Anelace, you're still at it?
A-at what...?
...Remember, Renne said earlier. ||| This world might change according to people's wishes...
Y-yes. I did hear that, but...
So this girl's trying her hardest to make a stuffed animal appear.
Hey, be quiet! ||| You're breaking my concentration.
Fluffy Pom's round little eyes. ||| The Lovely Bear, the fluffy panda... ||| Ehehe... Which one should I pick...
...Aren't you a bit too scatterbrained? ||| Narrow it down to one.
...She seems plenty happy even without a Gospel...
Oh, Estelle and Joshua.
Oh, Estelle.
...Anelace, I heard from Scherazard... ||| that you once fought this Colonel.
You hear that, Estelle? ||| ...Apparently this girl once fought that Colonel.
Huh, really...?
Ehehe, a lot happened... ||| It just kind of turned into a match.
It was thanks to Brigadier General Cassius. ||| I got to swing my unworthy sword.
I-I see. ||| Come to think of it, we fought him once too...
Yeah, we barely won, and that was four against one...
I-I see. ||| Come to think of it, we fought him once too... ||| We barely won, and that was four against one...
Ha, it's only a bitter memory now...
Hmph, the sword style he learned straight from old man Cassius, right? ||| I'd like a match with him myself, given the chance.
(No, please don't expect that much of me...)
...Anelace, I heard from Scherazard... ||| that you once fought that Colonel.
I was surprised when I heard it too.
He apparently learned his swordsmanship straight from old man Cassius... ||| Heh, I'd like a match with him myself, given the chance.
Hmm, but I think I've gotten a bit stronger since then... ||| Maybe I should ask the Colonel for another match...
(No, like I said, I'm not a colonel...)
Oh, Ries. Is your injury all better now?
Yes, no problem. I managed to avoid a direct hit.
Ehehe, but you really did come to help us, didn't you. ||| You saved us.
Ehehe, but you really did go to help Kevin and the others, didn't you.
...I thought about what you said, Anelace, in my own way. ||| Just as Kevin aimed to become a knight, I too have my reasons for being here as an apprentice. ||| So...
...I see. ||| Yeah, all that's left is to give Kevin a good talking-to once he wakes up!
...Yes. ||| Um, thank you.
Hehe, don't mention it.
Um... ||| Anelace and Ries seem to get along well.
Ahem, the reason is simple. ||| It's because Ries is cute!!
I-I see, that makes sense...
Yeah, we got Estelle freed safely too... ||| Now we can all relax once Kevin wakes up.
Oh, Senior Scherazard. ||| Have you met Ries yet? ||| Hehe, she's a little odd, but she's really fun.
Senior Scherazard, let's go over to the bookshelves! ||| There's a slightly odd nun there... ||| and she's the cutest!
Ries is a little odd, you know... ||| but she's the cutest nun ever!
Senior Scherazard, are you listening?
Kevin explained to Joshua the words that were inscribed on the obsidian monolith.
............... ||| ...It seems the Black Knight awaits in the final realm. ||| And for some reason, he's specifically requested me.
Yeah... looks that way. ||| Joshua, what do you plan to do?
Of course... I intend to accept the invitation. ||| I'm ready on my end, so please let me join you anytime.
Joshua...
Um...
Joshua...
B-Big Brother...
...Joshua.
...It's fine. Whatever happens, I'll be all right. ||| For now, let's just think about pressing forward.
